d:
Raipur–Visakhapatnam Expressway Package 3 in Chhattisgarh is one of the most challenging and important sections of this mega project. This package includes a 2.83 km long six-lane twin tunnel, animal underpasses, viaducts, and passes through dense forest & hilly terrain.
What’s Covered in this Video:
Package 3 route & chainage details (99.500 km to 124.611 km)
Twin tunnel entry & exit points update
Viaducts & animal underpass construction details
Tiger corridor & Sitanadi Wildlife Sanctuary connection
Land issues & delayed work start in Package 3
Odisha–Chhattisgarh border update
